scope: Official London borough and borough-linked architecture/development source audit for round122_london_borough_major_schemes. Sources were selected because they are council project pages, council news releases, committee/minutes pages, CPO document pages, or official borough accountability documents rather than generic Planning London Datahub rows.

source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Official council web page; retain attribution and use factual metadata only pending detailed reuse review.
source_audits.coverage_years: Timeline entries from 2020 through winter 2023/2024.
source_audits.update_frequency: Unstated; page is current project/status content.
source_audits.required_caveats: Season-level entries such as summer 2021 and winter 2023 are approximate and must not be converted into exact days.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use for separate planning, construction-start and completion milestones.
